submission.justification: K1 has the best resolution (about 2.97% at 5 cm) but its background is 2 cpkgd. That is 4 times the 0.5 cpkgd budget, so it is not suitable for low-background operation. K2 meets the budget at 0.1 cpkgd, but its best FWHM is 8.33%. K3 meets the budget at 0.3 cpkgd and has the best resolution of the eligible crystals. Its FWHM is 4.31% at 4.5 cm, against 4.58% at 4 cm and 4.436% at 5 cm. The 4.5 cm point is the best one simulated, but the scan is coarse, so the true optimum could lie slightly away from it.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: K3 background is 0.3 cpkgd, within the 0.5 cpkgd budget. K1 at 2 cpkgd exceeds the budget and was excluded.
4.5 cm is within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K3 at 4.5 cm gives 4.31% FWHM, the best among the budget-compliant options. K2 reaches only 8.326%. K1 is better (2.97%) but is ineligible. The thickness scan was coarse (0.5 cm steps near the optimum).
